baseline_observation.observed: Japanese, lowercase English and mixed-case English structured generation requests all SUSPEND/UNKNOWN with CAPABILITY_UNAVAILABLE and no dependency. Separate inspect preserves the exact request and full result.

implemented_route: Input recognizes exact Japanese headers コードを生成して: / ： and ASCII-case-insensitive code-generate:, retaining the original JSON body including CRLF/padding. Unsupported extra requests remain unresolved.

Core invokes a pure native generator. Shared strict JSON framing rejects duplicate decoded keys and retains original numeric lexemes; root fields are exactly 仕様 and 定数. The explicit specification supplies the algorithm and no example/expected result selects it.

The generator supports every inherited structured expression/statement form, with fixed operator/builtin mappings and parenthesized text. Constants remain a raw separate dictionary; source contains constant-key lookups. Reserved/noncanonical identifiers, unknown fields/operators/calls, missing constants and finite-bound violations stop explicitly.

A digest-bound report stores exact input/specification/constants spans, actual source/SHA, signature and constructed AST bounds. Core emits the exact Python source through its compute/content/render graph and checks any requested authorized local file receipt before COMMIT.

command_results.cause_and_resolution: The test incorrectly expected INVALID_JSON_DOCUMENT for a decoded duplicate key. Existing strict parser returns DUPLICATE_JSON_KEY; the oracle was corrected, the failed state/log retained and all four new CLI tests passed. Product source was unchanged.

route_observations.evidence: Padded exact JSON body is retained in the sealed intent and report. An independently written complete expected source for the conditional square-sum algorithm matches actual rendered bytes; signature, 17 IR nodes, 45 AST nodes/depth 8, source/root spans, parent report and compute/content/render artifacts are checked.

Five arithmetic operators, six comparisons, conditional expressions, lists, subscript and ten builtin mappings generate source; empty root/branch/loop blocks, escaped constant keys, inert code-looking constant values and an unbound reference are covered. These CLI tests check generation and NOT_RUN status. Independent finite semantics observations are recorded separately below.

route_observations.evidence: Changing threshold 2 to 731 leaves source bytes and source SHA unchanged while raw constants differ. An explicit version-2 algorithm change from addition to subtraction creates new source/SHA, preserves the original result in prior_results, and an exact old retry returns that original without replacing the current projection.

The file equals actual generated UTF-8 source and its CONFIRMED receipt target/hash/observed bytes. Required file graph consumption reads the actual receipt. Exact retry preserves bytes/mtime, and changing the source under a new version without a file request leaves the old file and single original action intact. This does not establish physical/remote exactly-once semantics.

All are SUSPEND/UNKNOWN with no result dependency and persisted complete results. Unknown syntax in a false branch is still rejected. Duplicate decoded keys retain DUPLICATE_JSON_KEY; trailing bytes retain INVALID_JSON_DOCUMENT. Selected large/deep/list/text inputs stop; this is not a complete admission/failure matrix.
